qAndA.question: What type of microbe is associated with food poisoning?
What tool was required to see viruses for the first time?
What are the so-called yeast cells?

qAndA.answer: The narrator compares the size of protozoa and fungi to human body cells, making it easier to grasp their microscopic nature.
qAndA.question: How does the video create a sense of scale when discussing microbes?

qAndA.answer: Primarily informative and educational, with a neutral tone. The inclusion of SARS-CoV-2 adds a touch of gravity due to its current global impact.

trimmingSuggestions.description: Reduce Static Time: Shorten the display time of the initial static image with text labels (Scene 1). Consider fading it out sooner as the narrator starts speaking.
Transition Between Images: Introduce more dynamic transitions between the images of different microbes to maintain visual interest. Simple fades or wipes would be effective.
Visual Variety: Integrate additional visuals, such as microscopic footage or animations of microbes, to enhance the visual appeal and complement the narration.
